mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.file_runner_command(command_id,space_id,workspace_id,operation_id,generation,fence,owner_id,runner_instance_id,request_hash,image_id,policy_hash) VALUES(#{command.operation.commandId},#{command.operation.spaceId},#{command.operation.workspaceId},#{command.operation.id},#{command.operation.generation},#{command.operation.fence},#{command.operation.ownerId},#{runner},#{hash},#{command.operation.helperImageId},#{command.operation.helperPolicyHash}) ON CONFLICT(command_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: command_id=#{command.operation.commandId} AND space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND owner_id=#{command.operation.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.operation.generation} AND fence=#{command.operation.fence} AND runner_instance_id=#{runner}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.file_runner_command SET container_id=#{container} WHERE AND container_id IS NULL AND NOT start_requested
UPDATE pf.file_runner_command SET start_requested=true WHERE AND container_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT start_requested
UPDATE pf.file_runner_command SET started_at=#{time} WHERE AND start_requested AND started_at IS NULL
UPDATE pf.file_runner_command SET exec_id=#{exec} WHERE AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND exec_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_runner_command c WHERE c.command_id=#{command.operation.commandId} AND c.space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND c.workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_runner_stop_proof p WHERE p.runner_instance_id=c.runner_instance_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_runner_instance i WHERE i.id=#{observer} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_runner_stop_proof p WHERE p.runner_instance_id=i.id)))
